Schools’ Green Initiative Challenge:
• Invested KShs. 13 million in Phase IX of the program
planting 30,000 trees across 100 schools in Kitui,
Machakos and Embu counties, restoring 20.3 hectares of
land.
• Trained 200 teachers on environmental sustainability
skills for knowledge transfer to their learners, raising
the cumulative total to 1,400 teachers equipped with
curriculum-integrated sustainability skills.
Enoosupukia Adopt-a-Forest Project
• Growing 12,855 trees across 10 hectares towards securing
water catchment resources vital for sustainable energy
production and community livelihoods.
Ndula Re-afforestation Project
• Successfully planted 1,800 trees covering 2.3 hectares and
contributing to the regeneration of degraded land.
